scripts.test:matrix-deadline: npm --prefix chunk-processor test -- --runInBand && npm --prefix compaction-processor test -- --runInBand && npm --prefix pdf-generation run test:local-export-runner
scripts.build:pdf-shared: npm run build:pdf-export-policy && npm run build:pdf-table-layout && npm run build:csv-file && npm run build:document-print
scripts.build:pdf-shared:local: npm run build:pdf-export-policy:local && npm run build:pdf-table-layout:local && npm run build:csv-file:local && npm run build:document-print:local
scripts.local:export-runner:build: npm run build:pdf-shared:local && npm --prefix chunk-processor run build && npm --prefix compaction-processor run build && npm --prefix mark-failed run build
scripts.local:export-runner: npm run local:export-runner:build && LOCAL_EXPORT_RUNNER_REQUIRED=true node --env-file=.env.local-export-runner pdf-generation/local-function-url.js
scripts.local:export-runner:watch: npm run local:export-runner:build && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names chunks,compaction,mark-failed,runner --prefix-colors blue,magenta,cyan,green "npm --prefix chunk-processor run build:watch" "npm --prefix compaction-processor run build:watch" "npm --prefix mark-failed run build -- --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "LOCAL_EXPORT_RUNNER_REQUIRED=true node --watch --watch-preserve-output --env-file=.env.local-export-runner pdf-generation/local-function-url.js"
